task.description:
Run all tests for API-10 (Rate limiting). Execute:
  zig build test

Verify that all test cases from tests/specs/API-10.md pass. Write a structured test report to tests/reports/API-10-test-report.md.

Report must include:
- Run timestamp
- Each test case ID from the spec with PASS/FAIL status
- Any failure details (actual vs expected)
- Overall summary: N passed, M failed
acceptance_criteria: All test cases from tests/specs/API-10.md are covered
result.status = PASS if all tests pass, FAIL if any test fails
